payload.comparison_population: patients with hepatic fibrosis, chronic hepatitis, or fatty liver
payload.supporting_quote: Hyaluronan levels (microg/l) were significantly higher in patients with liver cirrhosis (cirrhosis n = 127, mean 440, 95% CI 367-515) (P < 0.0001) compared with hepatic fibrosis (n = 23, mean 144, 95% CI 69-190), chronic hepatitis (n = 60, mean 63, 95% CI 37-91) and fatty liver (n = 11, mean 107, 95% CI 37-177).
a hyaluronan level > 100 microg/l had a 78% specificity and 83% sensitivity for diagnosing cirrhosis
